title: Ohio court upholds 183-year-old restriction protecting public square from developers' access plans
summary_full: In a significant ruling, an Ohio court has reinforced an 1843 land-use regulation aimed at maintaining a public square integral to community life. Originally donated to Parkman Township by Simon and Nancy Perkins, this 2.63-acre area faced legal challenges from developers, but the court ultimately sided with the township, emphasizing their duty to uphold the community's interests. This decision underscores the importance of preserving historical public spaces.
